title: RS Nodes: ComfyUI LoRA Training for Video
summary: A suite of custom ComfyUI nodes optimized for high-performance video generation and memory-efficient LoRA training, specifically for LTX-Video models. It features the proprietary Rose optimizer, enabling training on consumer GPUs with as little as 11GB VRAM.
research_notes: Features the Rose optimizer, a custom stateless PyTorch optimizer developed by RichServo that significantly reduces memory overhead compared to 8-bit AdamW.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from a utility node collection into a comprehensive training ecosystem for LTX-Video, introducing conditioning-safe LoRAs and integration with MOSS-TTS for synchronized audio-video workflows.
